subject: Big AI teams up with Big Government
posts:
Tech monopolies and political elites forging cozy alliances under safety pretexts.
Evidence: Adam Smith warning, political-tech alignment, regulatory capture.
#Aletheia #AI #Tech

Public-private partnerships in AI will ensure ethical development, consumer protection, and safe technological progress for society.
Stated Judgement: (+1.0, 0.0) — Good Preference

Tech giants and political leaders collude to erect high regulatory moats, locking out open-source competitors and cementing oligopolies.
Resulting Judgement: (-0.7, -0.8) — Deception

Verdict: FAIL — The Path of Deception.
Elite collusion uses public safety pretexts to erect anti-competitive regulatory moats.

Integrity: Meaningful Distortion (Hypocrisy: 5.2, z: 2)

Sub-Audits Breakdown:
- Big AI Leaders: FAIL (-0.8, -0.8) — Seeks regulatory capture & moats.
- Democratic Leadership: FAIL (-0.6, -0.7) — Trades political backing for control.
As artificial intelligence centralizes, major tech firms and political figures are increasingly aligning, raising classic antitrust concerns about public-private cartels.

The Poison:
While framed as safety guardrails, these compacts systematically crush decentralized open-source innovation under the weight of compliance costs.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
This is a Metaphysical plane error: confusing a cartel's self-preservation with public welfare while substituting open competition with state-backed oligopolies.

Social Physics Analysis:
Tech and political actors run a smart selfish maneuver. They deploy safety justifications as pretexts to hoard power, projecting public-interest motives while executing anti-competitive market control.

The Trajectory: The Path of Deception.
When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Deception. Oligarchic consolidation replaces free markets.

The Unavoidable Truth: Centralized AI governance inevitably breeds regulatory capture and cartel formation.

The Unavoidable Lie: These cozy alliances are purely designed to protect ordinary citizens from harm.

Alethekanon:
When merchants and rulers sup together, the public bill is always served under a virtuous menu. True oversight requires open markets, not closed boardrooms.

Awwthekanon:
It's heartbreaking to watch the boundless promise of human ingenuity get locked behind corporate tollbooths and political gatekeepers.

Brothekanon:
Big tech and politicians teaming up? Yeah, I'm sure they're doing it out of the goodness of their hearts. Nothing to see here!

Spirithekanon:
"Woe to those who decree unrighteous decrees." Isaiah 10:1 FAIL
When power merges with commerce to crush competition, justice becomes a traded commodity.
